import marimo as mo
import plotly.graph_objects as go

_fig = go.Figure(go.Scatter(x=[1,2,3,4,5,6], y=[2,5,3,8,6,9], mode="markers", marker=dict(size=14,color="#4f86ec")))
_fig.update_layout(title="点击一个点，或用框选 / 套索选择多个点", dragmode="select", height=420, margin=dict(l=35,r=15,t=55,b=35))
chart = mo.ui.plotly(_fig)
chart

selected = chart.value
_lines = ["## 下游分析", f"已选择 **{len(selected)}** 个点。"]
if selected:
    _lines.extend(["", "| x | y |", "| --- | --- |"])
    _lines.extend(f"| {_point.get('x', '')} | {_point.get('y', '')} |" for _point in selected)
else:
    _lines.append("\n请在左侧图像中选择。")
mo.md("\n\n".join(_lines[:2]) + "\n" + "\n".join(_lines[2:]))
